channel.title: Protobooth Changelog
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
• Publish button is now green and reads "Publish" (or "Update") to stand out
  • After publishing, a new "Link with Description" box shows an AI-generated summary of the prototype alongside the share link, with one click to copy both together

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
• Sign in with GitHub directly (via the Invoca Protobooth GitHub App) instead of pasting a personal access token
  • Open Session: paste a DevSpace prototype URL to check out its chat history and versions locally, with a prompt to pull when a newer version is published
  • Published versions now show who published them
  • Organize prototypes into folders in the sidebar, with drag-to-reorder and collapse/expand
  • A new prototype appears in the sidebar immediately, gets an AI-suggested name after its first generation, and can be renamed manually at any time
  • Sidebar rows show a live loading indicator while a prototype is generating
  • Switch freely between prototypes while one is generating — work on several at once without losing progress

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
• Fix a bug where a stray trailing newline/space from copy-pasting an API key or GitHub PAT into Settings would silently corrupt the stored credential, causing the first design attempt to fail with a generic error
  • Show the real error (HTTP status and response body) instead of a generic message when a GitHub or Anthropic request fails
  • Add placeholder hints (sk-ant-..., ghp_...) to the Settings fields

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description: Fixes: pasting a screenshot (e.g. via CleanShot) now attaches it as an image instead of inserting the file path as text; fixed misaligned paperclip icon in the chat input.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description: First signed, notarized release of Protobooth, with Sparkle auto-update support.
